audience: tree-service companies that run clients, projects, proposals and work orders in ArborNote

useCases.title: Review open proposals and their totals
useCases.text: List the proposals created or changed in a date range. Open one to read its status, total, line items and approve link.

useCases.title: Check this week's work orders and crew hours
useCases.text: List the work orders with their schedule and progress. Read the crew arrival and departure times for the same dates.

useCases.title: Plan a proposal from the tagged trees
useCases.text: Open a project and list its tagged trees with species, dimensions, health and work objectives. Use the list to prepare the next proposal.

useCases.title: Set up a new client and job site
useCases.text: Create the client record first, then the project at the job site with its client details. Both tools add records; no existing record changes.

useCases.title: Set the job number and tax on an estimate
useCases.text: Set the job number and the tax rate on a proposal's estimate. Each call replaces the earlier value on that proposal.
